```{python}
from pathlib import Path
from scripts.summarizer import BuscoSummarizer, SeqkitSummarizer
```

Name directories where results are

```{python}
busco_dir = Path(
    "data/2024_Tylototriton_vietnamensis_Wild_Genomes/Linh_Analysis/results/production_run/genome_qc/busco"
)
seqkit_dir = Path(
    "data/2024_Tylototriton_vietnamensis_Wild_Genomes/Linh_Analysis/results/production_run/genome_qc/seqkit"
)
```

Summmarize results from BUSCO runs based on vertebrata_odb12 lineage
```{python}
vert_result_folders_list = [
    "01_init_prim_hifi_asm",
    "02_hifi_asm_filtered_fcs_gx",
    "03_hifi_asm_filtered_fcs_adaptor",
    "04_hifi_asm_purged_dups_05_15_90_asm5",
    "04_hifi_asm_purged_dups_submitted",
]

vertebrata_run = BuscoSummarizer(
    busco_dir, "vertebrata_odb12", vert_result_folders_list
)
busco_summary_condensed_df = vertebrata_run.condensed_summary()
busco_summary_condensed_df
```

Summmarize seqkit stats to find the number and length of sequences
```{python}
chosen_result_folders_list = [
    "01_init_prim_hifi_asm",
    "02_hifi_asm_filtered_fcs_gx",
    "03_hifi_asm_filtered_fcs_adaptor",
    "04_hifi_asm_purged_dups_05_15_90_asm5",
    "04_hifi_asm_purged_dups_submitted",
]

seqkit_run = SeqkitSummarizer(seqkit_dir, chosen_result_folders_list)
seqkit_summary_df = seqkit_run.summary()
seqkit_condensed_df = seqkit_run.condensed_summary()

seqkit_condensed_df
```
